checkpoint_chronology.manifest_state: The checkpoint is content-addressed, but no checkpoint-bound accession, BioProject, sample, donor, or release-alias manifest was found for the declared paired MiniAtlas pretraining corpus.
checkpoint_chronology.pretraining_summary: More than 100,000 paired RNA-ATAC cells across 19 tissues and 56 cell types; the MiniAtlas dataset card exposes full-atlas and Kidney/PBMC/BMMC files without accession-level provenance.

gse244832.allowed_use: No benchmark use until code terms, safe loading, vocabulary/reference mapping, and corpus exposure resolve. If admitted later, use only donor-compatible observed-ATAC diagnostics; never claim cell pairing between its RNA and ATAC aliquots.
gse244832.evidence: GSE244832 became public on 2024-11-13, before the checkpoint was uploaded. The checkpoint-bound pretraining accession manifest is absent.
gse244832.model_access: A GSE244832 external-development score may use deterministic inference only after admission; no source cells, labels, prototypes, fine-tuning, calibration, or vocabulary fitting may enter that scored model.

gse281367.allowed_use: No benchmark use until all model and dataset gates resolve. If admitted later, observed-ATAC representation only under donor-grouped development folds.
gse281367.evidence: The BioProject was registered before the checkpoint and locally exposed source artifacts exist, but no checkpoint-corpus accession manifest was found. Publication chronology alone cannot exclude private or aliased inclusion.
gse281367.model_access: No claim that the upstream encoder is unexposed. Any downstream head or adaptation remains outer-training-only and the source has only 12 donors.

gse289173.allowed_use: None under the current sealed tasks because EpiFoundation requires observed ATAC and has no sequence-based signed variant-effect output, whereas the evaluator exposes RNA-only nuclei and eQTL/ieQTL summaries.
gse289173.evidence: The checkpoint was uploaded on 2025-02-04, before GSE289173 submission on 2025-02-10 and public release on 2025-02-12. This favorable public chronology does not replace the absent checkpoint-bound corpus manifest or establish exclusion of private/aliased data.
gse289173.model_access: No sealed feature or outcome access. Modality incompatibility is terminal even if corpus exclusion were later established.

gse296875.allowed_use: Potential same-nucleus observed-ATAC development diagnostics only after terms, safe loading, exact vocabulary/reference mapping, deterministic tokenization, and dataset activation gates pass.
gse296875.evidence: GSE296875 became public on 2025-10-01, after the immutable checkpoint upload and selected revision. Public-release chronology alone does not show when the underlying biological material or processed data existed, and the checkpoint-bound corpus lacks an accession/sample/donor collection manifest.
gse296875.model_access: Any fine-tuning, head, prototype, feature crosswalk learned from data, normalization, or calibration uses outer-training donors only. Held nuclei receive deterministic inference only.

rules.checkpoint_identity: Only pretrain.pth at the registered Hugging Face revision, exact SHA-256, and complete companion vocabulary hashes is in scope. No newer, mutable, or locally converted artifact substitutes without its own immutable lineage.
rules.exposure: Overall and source-specific exposure remains unknown for GSE244832, GSE281367, GSE289173, and GSE296875 because none can be excluded from the unmanifested upstream corpus using public-release dates alone.
rules.modality: The ATAC-derived CLS embedding cannot enter an RNA-only sealed cell task. Consuming observed held ATAC cannot count as RNA-conditioned ATAC prediction.
rules.pairing: GSE296875 is same-nucleus. GSE244832 is same-sample different aliquot; no cell-to-cell pairing is permitted.
rules.reference: Freeze exact EpiFoundation ATAC peak and RNA gene vocabularies, their native genome/annotation identities, and auditable mappings to GRCh38.p14/GENCODE v49. An unmapped token is missing, not zero.
